transcript: Yesterday I went to the public storing production of The Comedy of errors. This is part of Mobile Unit, an initiative by the public to bring theater to everyone by presenting free Shakespeare plays in public spaces across all five boroughs of New York City. Yesterday's performance was in Hamilton Heights around 140 third street. This production of comedy of errors is a one act bilingual adaptation with scenes in musical numbers in English and Spanish. It was funny and joyful and really awesome to experience theater out in the community with people from the surrounding neighborhoods and people of all ages. This type of work is what makes me really excited about the future of theater and theater accessibility, and I'm so grateful to be living in a place like New York where this type of production can happen. The tour around the Bros is almost finished, but I believe they're gonna be doing some performances their downtown Manhattan location over the next couple of weeks, so definitely check it out. As well as their upcoming hamlet production this summer in Central Park.
